video.title: I Picked Draper to Win It All (because of 3 patterns you can practice tomorrow)

classification.reason: Analyzes pro match patterns to teach three tactical and technical takeaways for improving singles play and forehand margin.

problem.title_as_question: How can players avoid hitting high-risk, low-reward shots and instead build effortless offensive pressure through margin?
problem.definition: Players often try to end points too quickly by hitting difficult flat slapshots that yield minimal reward, or conversely decelerate when told to play safe, instead of maintaining full racket head speed with high net clearance.

symptoms.description: Hitting high-difficulty flat slap-shots that slow down on the court and leave the player in the exact same rally position.
Missing outright by attempting low-percentage, crazy shots from defensive positions.
Slowing down the swing and hesitating when attempting to play safe or patient.

causes.statement: Players hit the ball too hard trying to win points in one shot, getting negligible reward for massive risk taken.
Players misunderstand patience and margin as an instruction to slow down the swing rather than taking a full swing with high net clearance.
Players attempt flat slapshots with extreme degree of difficulty where successful execution does not sufficiently advance the state of the point.
Under defensive pressure, players gamble on low-margin winners instead of floating high balls into the court to force the opponent to earn it.

angles.summary: Using racket head speed to hit high over the lowest part of the net produces heavy depth with massive margin for error.
Playing with margin does not mean slowing the swing down, which is counterproductive and leads to hesitation.
Rafael Nadal tilts the risk-reward ratio in his favor by using height and heavy spin to large targets rather than risky flat winners.
Accept that opponents will occasionally hit winners against high-margin shots, because long-term winning is based on math and frequencies.

solutions.summary: Commit to full, unhesitating swings while visualizing higher net clearance and safe targets rather than decelerating.
solutions.external_goal: Visualize high net clearance over the center strap

solutions.summary: When stretched on defense, float the ball high over the middle and into the court to reset the point and make the opponent earn it.
solutions.external_goal: High over the middle of the net into deep court

solutions.summary: On return targeting and rally shots, take a full swing aimed high over the middle of the net into big targets deep enough to prevent attack, throwing away low-reward difficult shots.
solutions.external_goal: High over the middle of the net into big target zones
